name: Dynamic Warm-Up
steps: March in place for 30 seconds, swinging your arms.
Do 10 slow arm circles forward and 10 backward.
Do 10 hip circles each way and 10 gentle bodyweight squats.

name: Cool-Down Stretch
steps: Walk slowly for one minute until your breathing settles.
Hold each stretch for 20–30 seconds: quads, hamstrings, calves, chest, shoulders.
Breathe deeply and never stretch into pain.

name: Brisk Walk
steps: Walk at a pace where you can talk but not sing.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and swing your arms.
Land heel to toe and keep your head up.

name: March in Place
steps: Stand tall and lift your knees to hip height alternately.
Swing your opposite arm with each step.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe evenly.

name: Step-Ups
steps: Use a sturdy step or bottom stair.
Step up with one foot, bring the other up, then step down.
Alternate the leading leg every minute.

name: Shadow Boxing
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, hands up.
Throw controlled jabs and crosses in the air.
Stay light on your feet and keep your core tight.

name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Start standing with feet together.
Jump feet out while raising arms overhead.
Jump back and repeat at a steady pace.

name: High Knees
steps: Run in place driving your knees up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest tall and your core braced.

name: Mountain Climbers
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch quickly.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.

name: Burpees
steps: Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Return your feet in and jump up with arms overhead.

name: Jump Squats
steps: Lower into a squat with chest up.
Explode upward, leaving the ground.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

name: Sit-to-Stand (Chair Squat)
steps: Sit on the front of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart.
Stand up by pushing through your heels without using your hands.
Lower slowly back down with control.

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to about 90°.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.

name: Lunges
steps: Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are about 90°.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso upright.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body forms a line.
Pause for a second, then lower slowly.

name: Calf Raises
steps: Stand tall, holding a wall for balance if needed.
Rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Lower slowly with control.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are about 90°.
Keep your knees over your ankles and breathe normally.
Hold, then slide back up.

name: Wall Push-Up
steps: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.

name: Knee Push-Up
steps: Start on hands and knees, hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with a straight line from head to knees.
Press back up.

name: Push-Ups
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest to just above the floor, elbows at 45°.
Press up while keeping your body in one straight line.

name: Chair Dips
steps: Sit on a sturdy chair edge, hands beside your hips.
Slide forward and lower your body by bending your elbows to 90°.
Press back up without shrugging your shoulders.

name: Shoulder Taps
steps: Start in a high plank with feet wide for stability.
Tap one shoulder with the opposite hand.
Keep your hips still and alternate sides.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.
Hold for a second and lower slowly.

name: Bird Dog
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Extend your right arm and left leg until level with your back.
Return and switch sides without rotating your hips.

name: Reverse Snow Angels
steps: Lie face down, arms by your sides, palms down.
Lift your chest slightly and sweep your arms out and overhead.
Sweep back down with control.

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent over hips.
Lower your opposite arm and leg toward the floor.
Keep your lower back pressed down, then switch sides.

name: Plank Hold
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes with elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line and your glutes tight.
Breathe steadily for the prescribed time; stop early if your hips sag or your lower back hurts.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands lightly behind your head.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Alternate sides in a slow, controlled pedal.

name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie flat with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Raise your legs to vertical keeping your lower back down.
Lower slowly without touching the floor.

name: Knee Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side, forearm under your shoulder, knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to head.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Cat-Cow
steps: On hands and knees, arch your back and look up (cow).
Round your back and tuck your chin (cat).
Move slowly with your breath.

name: Single-Leg Balance
steps: Stand near a wall or chair for support.
Lift one foot slightly and balance on the other leg.
Switch legs after the hold.
